chunks: Al-Husayn ibn ʿUbayd Allah informed me, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Yahya, from his father, from Muhammad ibn Ahmad ibn Yahya, from ʿAli ibn Ismaʿil, from Hammad ibn ʿIsa, from Hariz, from Abi ʿAbd Allah عليه السلام, who said:
Whoever performed ghusl from janabah but did not wash his head, then afterward it occurred to him to wash his head, he has no choice but to repeat the ghusl.

key_terms.بَدَا: it occurred or became apparent to him afterward
key_terms.جَنَابَةٍ: the state of major ritual impurity requiring ghusl
key_terms.رَأْسَهُ: his head, whose washing is required in the proper sequence

ai.seo_question: If someone forgets to wash the head in ghusl al-janabah, must the ghusl be repeated?
ai.summary: This hadith states a legal ruling concerning ghusl from janabah and indicates that proper order must be observed. If a person omits washing the head and only later washes it, the entire ghusl must be repeated.
